did.unittitle: Rockefeller Family and Associates, Edward H. Burdick Management Files

physdesc.extent: 15 legal document boxes, 8 letter document boxes

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research, with selected files restricted as noted, in accordance with the terms of donation of the David Rockefeller estate.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Edward H. Burdick served as management staff in the joint-office of J. Richardson Dilworth, and later served as office manager, for the Rockefeller Family and Associates, Room 5600 at Rockefeller Center in New York city.

This collection consists of archives administration files of the Rockefeller family archives, 1956-1986, including the planning, development, and founding of the Rockefeller Archive Center; Budget and analysis documentation; as well as meeting records and reports for the Board of Managers, and later the Board of Directors and associated committees. Also documented are office management, staff directories, efficiency, future of work, and reorganization studies; and select investment files and reports from Rockefeller Brothers, Inc. (RBI), Venrock, and the Associates Captial Fund.

userestrict.head: Conditions Governing Use
userestrict.p: Rockefeller Archive Center has title, copyright and literary rights in the collection, in so far as it holds them, and has authority to grant permission to cite and publish material from the collection.
